history.summary: CSV LOCATION FLAG: this temple is NOT in Seoni district. The only verifiable 'Chhindi Mata Temple' is at SIWNI village near JAITHARI in ANUPPUR district, Madhya Pradesh (PIN 484330) - e.g. Bharatibiz lists 'Chhindi Mata Mandir, Siwni Jaithari, Anuppur' and Meta.ai's place page gives it coordinates near Jaithari. The founding dynasty, date and specific dedication of the goddess are undocumented; do not invent. Coordinates are approximate from the place listing (~2 km from Jaithari town centre). A googleusercontent photo of the temple timed out on preflight and other image searches returned unrelated temples; media left empty rather than risking a wrong image.

name: Chhindimatta Temple
town: Siwni village, Jaithari area, Anuppur district (CSV town 'Seoni' is WRONG - the temple is near Jaithari, PIN 484330, Anuppur district, eastern MP)
town_description: Jaithari is a town and tehsil in Anuppur district, eastern Madhya Pradesh, at the edge of the Maikal hills near the Chhattisgarh border - a forested coal-belt region. The Chhindi Mata temple stands at Siwni village by Jaithari (PIN 484330).
